road.title: Hello and goodbye
road.description: A long-limbed figure who has clearly been assembled in a hurry under a hat that has seen service, sitting on a trunk they will not discuss. Marigold is a Retired Echo and used to repeat things for a living and now waits, out of habit, for someone else to speak first.

road.description: A long-limbed figure who has clearly been assembled in a hurry under a hat that has seen service, sitting on a trunk they will not discuss. Marigold is a Retired Echo and used to repeat things for a living and now waits, out of habit, for someone else to speak first.

openObjectives.prompt: Marigold is plainly waiting to be greeted and will not be the one to start. Greet Marigold, using Italian.
Marigold is holding a list and a pencil, and you are not on the list. Tell Marigold your name, using Italian.
Marigold has asked how you are and, unusually, wants to know. Tell Marigold how you are, using Italian.

character.name: Marigold Cobbett
character.description: A long-limbed figure who has clearly been assembled in a hurry under a hat that has seen service, sitting on a trunk they will not discuss. Marigold is a Retired Echo and used to repeat things for a living and now waits, out of habit, for someone else to speak first.

npc.narrative: The sera is clear, and the sky has gone the colour of old tè. The alberi of the Coppice stand in a tidy fila, and at the end of it Marigold Cobbett waits, sola, in a queue of one. She holds a piccolo quaderno and looks at you, then at the empty aria, as if someone else should go first.
npc.native: Buonasera, buonasera. Qui aspetto in fila, da sola. Aspetti anche tu?
npc.translation: Good evening, good evening. Here I wait in line, by myself. Do you wait too?

verdict.overallFeedback: Nice start! You greeted Marigold in Italian and honestly said you didn't understand, which is a very useful phrase.

objectiveResults.feedback: Lovely, you greeted Marigold with "Ciao" and "Buonasera".
This one wants you to tell Marigold your name; we'll ask for it again a little later.
This one wants you to tell Marigold how you are; we'll ask for it again later.

openObjectives.prompt: Marigold is holding a list and a pencil, and you are not on the list. Tell Marigold your name, using Italian.
Marigold has asked how you are and, unusually, wants to know. Tell Marigold how you are, using Italian.

npc.narrative: The cielo is clear and the last light lies along the strada. Marigold leans toward you, lowering her voce as if the queue might overhear. Behind her there is no one, but she has left a polite gap anyway, in case of a prossimo.
npc.native: Piano, piano. Mi chiamo Marigold. Sono la prima in fila, e anche l'ultima.
npc.translation: Slowly, slowly. My name is Marigold. I am first in the queue, and also last.

verdict.overallFeedback: Lovely start! You introduced yourself to Marigold clearly and greeted her warmly in Italian.

objectiveResults.feedback: Well done, you told Marigold your name with "Mi chiamo Tom".
You didn't say how you are yet; Marigold would like to hear how you're doing, so she'll ask again a little later.

openObjectives.prompt: Marigold has asked how you are and, unusually, wants to know. Tell Marigold how you are, using Italian.

npc.narrative: The sera is clear, and Marigold leans toward you without moving her piedi, which the fila allows only on Tuesdays. You take un passo and stop dietro her, as the form requires. Above the strada, una stella waits its turn.
npc.native: Piacere, Tom! Io sto bene, ma la fila è lunga. Tu come stai?
npc.translation: Nice to meet you, Tom! I am fine, but the queue is long. How are you?

verdict.overallFeedback: Lovely! You told Marigold how you are, thanked her and asked her back, all in natural Italian.

objectiveResults.feedback: Well done, "Sto bene" is correct and tells Marigold how you are.

npc.narrative: Under the stelle, Marigold gives a piccolo nod, the kind she keeps for people who answer in order. She steps forward in the fila, leaving a posto behind her, exactly one person wide.
npc.native: Anch'io sto bene, grazie! Sei il secondo in fila, Tom. Che bella sera.
npc.translation: I am fine too, thank you! You are second in the queue, Tom. What a lovely evening.

player: Sì, bella sera! Ehm... fila? Non capisco 'fila'.

npc.narrative: Sotto le stelle, Marigold draws una linea in gesso sulla strada and stands very still behind it. La notte is quiet, the way a held breath is quiet. You are now, apparently, second in something.
npc.native: Una fila è questa: io qui, tu dietro di me. Due persone sono già una fila lunga. Capisci?
npc.translation: A queue is this: me here, you behind me. Two people are already a long queue. Do you understand?

npc.narrative: Under the stelle of a quiet notte, Marigold leans in as though your goodbye were a segreto. She writes it on a piccolo biglietto, then studies it for some time. Behind you the strada goes on, and the fila stays exactly where it was.
npc.native: Arrivederci, Tom! Questa è la mia ultima parola. Ora la collezione è completa. Buonanotte!
npc.translation: Goodbye, Tom! This is my last word. Now the collection is complete. Good night!
